help.title: Night Allowance & Overtime — calculation modes
help.intro: Night Allowance is paid only for days worked on a shift marked is_night_shift = 1 in attendance. LOP days never contribute. Two modes are available:
help.perNightExplanation: Per Night ₹ — a flat rupee amount per night worked, added on top of normal salary.
help.dayPayExplanation: × Day Pay — the whole salary of a night-shift employee is paid at the multiple. A value of 2 makes total gross equal base × 2. At least one night must be worked in the month.
help.exampleBase: Example base monthly gross used above: ₹166,666.
help.overtimeCount: OT days are days an employee was present on a week-off or holiday. The Attendance Grid marks these WOT/HOT automatically.
help.perOtExplanation: Per OT day ₹ — a flat rupee amount per OT day.
help.otDayPayExplanation: × Day Pay — multiplier × daily salary for each OT day. Unlike the night mode, this is per-day rather than whole-salary.
help.notesText: The allowance is taxable income, so EPF and TDS do not simply double. Net pay rises by less than gross. A night counts only for days actually worked on a night shift (half-days = 0.5).
